mealAnalysis.guidance_message: This meal appears to be grilled mixed meats with white rice, French fries, and lime, making it relatively high in refined carbohydrates and fat. For someone with diabetes, the white rice and fries may raise blood sugar levels more quickly, especially when combined in the same meal. It is best to avoid or strictly limit this meal, opting for whole grain rice or a high-fiber vegetable side instead.
mealAnalysis.meal_title: Grilled Mixed Meat Plate with White Rice and French Fries
mealAnalysis.meal_description: A plated meal consisting of grilled beef and pork cuts, white rice, French fries, and a lime half. The meal combines animal protein with two higher-glycemic starch sides.
